salvo: salvo14/mig/s6 (9 Nov 2026), lot k-moonshot. Autoformalization for Ambiguous Inputs (arXiv 2611.00340v1). Every aggregate table of the copy that holds a Kimi K3 or Kimi K2.6 row, b-moonshot and c-moonshot research rows merged: main Table 4 (paired F1 gain of the Kimi review feedback) and supplementary Tables S10, S13, S14, S15, S17, S18 (70 measures). Kimi is only the reviewer at AutoCedar's intent-review step; DeepSeek (deepseek-flash, thinking, low reasoning effort) generates and repairs: the measures are of the SYSTEM, not of Kimi alone. Not converted: the single-question case-study tables S19-S48 (one input each, authors' examples), the coverage counts of S4 (kept as item counts in notes), and tables without a Kimi row.
